perspective:
Ethan’s available information:

- Ethan knows he is a plumber and Gary is his long-time friend from middle school; Gary is a doctor.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Ethan felt concerned.
- Ethan invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation. He told Gary that his health mattered, that he hated seeing him like this, and suggested two days might give him a new perspective.
- Ethan heard Gary decline, saying he appreciated the concern but couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- Ethan was later with Gary at the retreat. He observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Ethan heard Gary say it was complicated and that he didn’t want to burden him.
- After the confrontation, Ethan heard Gary open up about pressures managing a new department and personal challenges. Ethan felt relief and empathy.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities, saying Gary didn’t have to do everything himself.
- Ethan heard Gary agree and say he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Ethan saw Gary making efforts to change and felt hopeful and proud.
- Ethan told Gary he was proud of his progress and reminded him he was there whenever Gary needed to talk.
- Ethan heard Gary say things were better, that he was less overwhelmed because of Ethan’s help, and that he had time for a movie last weekend.
- After a year, Ethan saw that Gary had adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and could manage on his own. Ethan felt satisfied and happy.
- Ethan told Gary he was always just a call away, that he knew Gary had this, and to keep up the great work.
- Ethan heard Gary thank him, say he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and that he felt more in control now.
